SELECT 'config' AS kind,service AS id,value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at) FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',json(payload),'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'event' AS kind,event_id AS id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) AS data FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache

SELECT 'pending' AS kind,b.booking_id AS id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',b.booking_id,json_object('request',e.request_id,'step',e.step,'status',b.status) FROM customer_events e JOIN bookings b ON b.request_id=e.request_id UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'cancel' AS kind,event_id AS id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) AS data FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('service',service,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE message LIKE '%reference%' OR message LIKE '%duplicate%' OR message LIKE '%CR-e87d23192fb4%' OR trace_id IN ('req_0069ee9be0d353a2b7400ec576f44bcd','req_bef86452ac125cadae5d3105fbd1c9e0')

SELECT 'incomplete_confirmed' AS check_name,COUNT(*) AS n FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_still_fulfilled',COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_refunds',COUNT(*) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND c.state='captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.charge_id=c.charge_id AND r.booking_id=b.booking_id AND r.amount_cents=c.amount_cents) UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sales',COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING COUNT(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold_flights',COUNT(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_bookings',COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_events',COUNT(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'refunds',COUNT(*) FROM refunds
